stage1.impression: A single glowing box in a room washed edge to edge in one flat red. It reads as a lamp more than a $20,000 loudspeaker: the bottom of the cabinet burns white, the horn on top is a dull slab the same tone as the wall behind it, and a red veil sits over everything, the product included. The wet floor is the weakest part. The puddles look like dark blob decals, and the reflection under the plinth is cut off by a puddle edge. It is a competent CG mood render, not a night photograph.

blocking_9: The frame falls to a real night black away from the light: the top corners and the outer wall at lum_median 12 or less, against 25 to 28 now, so the colour on the wall reads as a pool of light and not as a tint over the whole frame
No uniform haze veil over the product: the cabinet's edges and the horn's outline are crisp, and the haze shows only as beams
The bottom of the cabinet (ports and lens rim) holds detail: clip_pct under 15 in that region, against 43 now
The horn separates from the wall, as a lit or rim-lit silhouette with at least 15 levels of contrast at its edge
The wet paving reads as real concrete with small, irregular puddles and a whole, unbroken reflection of the speaker
The board-forming on the wall reads at a glance: the horizontal tie and board lines catch the grazing uplight

defects.what: The whole upper frame is a flat red wash (lum 25 to 54, no falloff to black at the corners). Haze glow fills the frame and it does not read as night.
Across the wall the light barely falls off from the centre (37 to 45 across the width); there is no pool of light.
The wall right above the speaker (lum 40) is darker than its flanks (54); the light's centre sits beside the speaker, not above it.
The horn reads as a flat panel with a dark blob, lum 47 against the wall behind at 40 to 55: its silhouette is lost.
The ports and the lower cabinet are blown out (43 percent clipped); the white lens rim at about y 670 to 690 is clipped too.
A haze veil in front of the product softens every edge of the cabinet, which reads milky.
The puddles are large, smooth, uniform blobs with a decal look, and their edges are soft and repetitive.
A puddle edge cuts the reflection of the speaker hard. It shows only the ports, so it reads as an error.
The ground is near black with no cool moonlight (g and b at 1 to 2); there is no second colour anywhere in the frame.
The board-formed concrete reads only as faint mottling; the board lines barely show.

changes.problem: The haze is so dense, and fills so much of the frame, that every pixel is lifted into red and the product sits behind a veil.

evidence.measured: Top-left corner lum_median 28.0 and top-right 25.0, against 40.7 on the wall above the speaker: almost no fall-off to the corners. Clipping over the cabinet is softened by a glow.

changes.expected: The haze shows only as the rising beams near the speaker and wall. The corners fall toward black, and the cabinet edges turn crisp because no haze lies between the camera and the speaker.

changes.problem: The uplight's 120 degree spread throws the light wide, onto the flanks of the wall and the room, so the colour has no centre and its brightest point is not above the speaker.

evidence.measured: Wall above the speaker lum_median 40.7; flanks [100,300,250,450] 54.2 and [550,300,700,450] 52.1; a horizontal profile at y 250 to 300 is flat at 35 to 45.

changes.expected: A brighter pool of colour rises above and behind the speaker and fades toward the frame's edges. The wall above the speaker becomes the brightest wall area, without lifting the corners.

changes.problem: The lower cabinet and the lens rim around the speaker's feet blow out to white, which reads as a lamp, not a product.

evidence.measured: clip_pct 43.5, lum_median 189.6; lens rim band [310,670,460,700] clip_pct 10.4

change.setting: set.props.3 emit, and the lens size
change.to: emit 0.08, size [0.57, 0.44] (the lens no wider than the speaker's footprint plus 5 mm, so no bare rim shows)

changes.expected: The ports and the bottom batts keep their texture and the lens glows only faintly around the feet. The bright white band under the cabinet disappears.

changes.problem: The puddles are big smooth blobs that look like decals, and one cuts the speaker's reflection off with a hard edge.

evidence.measured: The reflection shows only the ports (lum_p95 192.8), and a puddle edge cuts it hard just below the plinth. Around it are uniform dark blobs about 100 to 200 px across.

change.setting: set.props.1 wet / puddle_m, plus concrete.water ripple
change.to: wet 0.85, puddle_m 0.25, one continuous shallow puddle under and in front of the plinth (from y -1.2 to 0), ripple 0.15, ripple_m 0.04

changes.expected: The paving reads as damp concrete with small, irregular wet patches. A complete, slightly broken-up reflection of the whole speaker lies in front of the plinth.

changes.problem: The moonlight does not register at all, so the frame is one colour, the horn melts into the wall, and the ground has no form.

evidence.measured: Ground lum_median 10.1 with g_median 2 and b_median 2. Horn [320,385,460,465] lum 47.6 against the wall behind at 40 to 55.

change.to: irradiance 0.18, position [-3.5, 2.5, 5.0] (high, from behind-left, so it rims the horn and cabinet edges and grazes the wet paving)

changes.expected: A cool, faint rim runs on the horn's top and left edges and on the cabinet's left edge. Cool highlights on the wet paving give the frame a second colour that suits every flavour, Smoke included.

changes.problem: The concrete reads as mottled red plaster, not board-formed concrete.

evidence.measured: lum_range 29.5 (p5 37.1, p95 66.6) of soft mottling, with no visible board lines

change.to: bump 2.2, tex_scale 1.0 (boards about 150 mm high at true scale), vary 0.12

changes.expected: Horizontal board seams and tie holes catch the grazing uplight as fine light and dark lines, and the large tonal blotches calm down.

changes.problem: The speaker is small in a square frame with a lot of featureless upper wall, so it reads as a lamp in a room rather than the hero.

evidence.measured: The speaker with its horn fills about 22 percent of the width and 40 percent of the height. The top 45 percent of the frame is flat wash.

changes.expected: The speaker fills about 30 percent of the width, and the wall's colour pool still fills the frame above it. A lower eye gives the speaker presence and a longer reflection.

out_of_scope.request: A lighter horn interior, or detail inside the horn (it reads as a dark blob)
out_of_scope.why: The horn's shape and the resin's light transmission are fixed by the product and by acoustic simulation. Only the rim light in c5 may help, from outside.

out_of_scope.request: More light through the cabinet's top so the wall right above it is the brightest part
out_of_scope.why: The batts and the horn stop the light where they would in reality. The card forbids asking light to pass where the cabinet stops it, so c2 only reshapes the lamp's spread.
